structure_proposals.why: You already approved moving this ahead of the Push A lateral raise on 23 July, but that proposal carried no position for the app to apply, so nothing moved and it still ran sixth on both Push A nights since — this is the same change with the number it was missing.

Dips are a pressing movement, but on Push B they run sixth, behind six straight sets of crossovers and rear-delt flies — this moves them up behind the chest press so both of your Push B presses happen before the isolation work instead of after it.
